[[File:Sea Snake Young icon.png|left]]
'''Sea Snake Young''' are found in the [[Miscellania and Etceteria dungeon]], which can be entered during and after the [[Royal Trouble]] quest.

They attack with [[ranged]] and are notably vulnerable to slashing weapons. As they are quite difficult to click, [[Settings/Combat & Action Bar/Targeting|target cycle]] is useful.

This is one of the monsters that can drop the [[Giant snake spine]] required to complete the [[Fur 'n' Seek/Wish list|Fur 'n' Seek wishlist]].
